description: This file implements the core logic for merging notes within a Git repository, including handling of merge bases, conflict resolution strategies, and the management of a temporary worktree for notes merging.
external_methods: structs and macros like struct object_id, struct notes_merge_options, etc.

methods.name: void init_notes_merge_options(struct repository * r,struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Initializes the notes merge options structure with default values and the given repository.

methods.name: int notes_merge(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * local_tree,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Performs a three-way merge of notes between local and remote refs, handling conflicts and creating a merge commit if necessary.

methods.name: int notes_merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * partial_tree,struct commit * partial_commit,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Finalizes the notes merge by creating an actual commit object with the merged notes.

methods.name: int notes_merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing notes merge by cleaning up the temporary worktree directory.

methods.name: void diff_tree_local(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * changes,int len,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * local)
struct:notes_merge_pair * diff_tree_remote(struct notes_merge_options * o,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * remote,int * num_changes)
struct:notes_merge_pair * find_notes_merge_pair_pos(struct notes_merge_pair * list,int len,struct object_id * obj,int insert_new,int * occupied)
int ll_merge_in_worktree(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p)
int merge_changes(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * changes,int * num_changes,struct notes_tree * t)
int merge_from_diffs(struct notes_merge_options * o,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * local,const struct object_id * remote,struct notes_tree * t)
int merge_one_change(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p,struct notes_tree * t)
int merge_one_change_manual(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p,struct notes_tree * t)
int path_to_oid(const char * path,struct object_id * oid)
int verify_notes_filepair(struct diff_filepair * p,struct object_id * oid)
void write_buf_to_worktree(const struct object_id * obj,const char * buf,unsigned long size)
void write_note_to_worktree(const struct object_id * obj,const struct object_id * note)
